last_verified.normal_state: On codex/integration-next-phase, integrated development-foundation, capability/permission, App SDK contracts, Wayback host ledger, shared localization, and the Model Runtime/Model Store host foundation. The Model Runtime is PARTIAL: its 25 unit and 2 manifest/schema tests, format, Clippy, Nagi user-target library compile, and CRLF regression pass; the source Windows CI failure is recorded and fixed. No model weights, download, production inference, or runtime hook was added. The latest mainline M17 CI run #233 (36223836342) completed with FAILURE after target builds through UEFI; QEMU reached Servo construction, then hit a 512-byte Rust allocation failure without ordinary POSIX heap failure diagnostics. M17 remains BLOCKED and M18 remains NOT STARTED. The likely over-aligned allocation path is now handled by a bounded Nagi POSIX allocator path. Seven focused nagi-posix tests pass on x86_64 macOS, x86_64-target Clippy passes with warnings denied, and the Nagi user-target compile passes. The existing integration CI #36225995143 has both host jobs green and was at M17 QEMU acceptance before the aligned-allocation fix; it is not evidence for that fix. Dirty first-party UI/Home/Search and M17 diagnosis worktrees remain untouched.

ci_runs.summary: Mainline run #233: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed and target builds reached UEFI. QEMU reached Servo construction, then failed a 512-byte allocation and timed out at 120 seconds; no heap mapping/no-free-block diagnostic, pixel checksum, or M17 PASS marker.
Both host jobs passed DF-01 verification. The target build completed, then the unchanged M17 QEMU acceptance timed out before a web pixel.

Capability source-branch CI failed the old DF-01 test expecting IN_PROGRESS after development-foundation recorded PASS; isolated capability crate checks passed. The stale assertion is corrected in this integration branch.
App SDK source-branch CI failed the same old DF-01 status assertion; SDK format, Clippy, and build passed, target job skipped. The stale assertion is corrected in this integration branch.

Wayback source-branch CI passed formatting, lint, and build but both host test jobs failed an inherited DF-01 status assertion; the target job was skipped. The integration branch updates that stale assertion.
Pre-aligned-allocation integration checkpoint: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed; target job had reached M17 first-web-pixel QEMU acceptance. This run does not include commit 55be56d.
Localization source branch: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs and target builds through UEFI passed; only the unrelated M17 first-web-pixel QEMU acceptance failed.

Model Runtime source branch: Ubuntu host passed; Windows failed the newline-sensitive malformed-manifest fixture; target M17 acceptance failed independently after builds through UEFI. The CRLF regression is fixed in the integration tree.
